entities.name: PDN Connectivity Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing PDN connectivity initiated by UE.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by MME to reject PDN connectivity request from UE.

entities.name: PTI
entities.description: Procedure Transaction Identifier included in PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message.

entities.name: ESM cause
entities.description: Information element indicating reason for rejecting PDN connectivity request.

entities.name: Back-off timer value
entities.description: Optional IE included in PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message to indicate back-off timer.

entities.name: Re-attempt indicator
entities.description: Optional IE indicating whether UE is allowed to re-attempt connectivity procedure.

entities.name: T3482
entities.description: Timer associated with PDN connectivity procedure that is stopped upon receipt of PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by UE after receiving PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message.

entities.name: ESM cause #26 insufficient resources
entities.description: Condition when ESM cause value is #26 and specific access conditions apply.

entities.name: Emergency request type
entities.description: Condition when request type is set to emergency or handover of emergency bearer services.

relations.description: PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message contains PTI IE.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message contains ESM cause IE.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message may contain Back-off timer value IE.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message may contain Re-attempt indicator IE.
Receipt of PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message stops timer T3482.
Receipt of PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT causes UE to enter PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
ESM cause #26 with specific access conditions prevents inclusion of Back-off timer value IE.
Emergency request type prevents inclusion of Back-off timer value IE when ESM cause is #26.
